name: invoke_strided
description: Strided callback loop compiled with native LTCG so the internal register convention (count in EAX, cursor in ECX, callback in EBX, stride on the stack) matches retail.

functions.name: InvokeStridedCallback
functions.actual_abi: count in EAX; cursor in ECX; callback in EBX; stride at [ESP+4]; RET 4

context.description: Synthetic caller that establishes the observed register convention; not recovered game code.
